title: How early can I seek ABA therapy services for my child at Pinnacle Blooms?
metaTitle: Early ABA Therapy for Children with Autism - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the benefits of early ABA therapy for children diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder at Pinnacle Blooms Network, and how it can help your child's development.
html: In Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe that early intervention is the key for positive outcomes. As such, ABA therapy can begin as soon as a diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disorder is made. This can typically be around the age of 18 months to 2 years. Our dedicated and skilled therapists are trained to work with children at all developmental stages, providing support that is tailored uniquely to your child's needs.
